summary: MakeMyTrip Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 17, 2026, announcing that its wholly-owned subsidiary MMT India has confidentially filed a draft red herring prospectus for a proposed initial public offering and listing on Indian stock exchanges. The offering involves a sale of equity shares by MakeMyTrip and its subsidiary ibibo Holdings. Post-offering, MMT India will remain a subsidiary. The proceeds will strengthen MakeMyTrip's cash position for growth, strategic initiatives, and repurchases. This is a proactive subsidiary IPO to enhance brand visibility and talent incentives. There is no target, acquirer, or deal terms. Watch for regulatory approvals and potential cross-listing fungibility between India and U.S. markets.
